title: not an issue but feature request: speaking the number of the delta instead of labels
body: I would like to request the possibility that Xdrip includes a toggle so one can select whether it speaks the label (e.g. "consistent" when changes in delta are very low..) or alternatively it speaks the number (plus one dot five). This is very relevant for people using xdrip while practising sports like me (biking). It is relevant how much it changes instead of the text included in the label. Can this be done? Thanks!

comments.body:
Can you clarify what you are asking for?
Can you include what xDrip does now including an example and what you want it to do in case of your example?

And I ask you to please close this issue if you can accomplish your objective using a work-around?
The xDrip code will become more and more complicated, and harder to maintain, if we keep adding capabilities to it.
